title: The main-checkout guard starts grep for every command
what: Match the command against its patterns in Python (re) instead of starting `grep -E` for each pattern, keeping the same verdicts (the guard's tests are the check); if POSIX classes need translating, translate them once at load.
why: Measured 29 Oct by the gate-speed design: one test run starts 4,515 grep processes, from the guard hook matching each command against POSIX patterns with `grep -E` (guard_main.py:88). The hook runs on every Bash call of every session, so each command pays the process starts. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: 29 Oct, master ee932b26: one library test run starts 4,515 grep processes, all from guard_main.py:88.
pass_cases: The guard starts no grep; its tests give the same verdicts.
